remarks: Framed by classic stone walls, fruit trees, and lush grounds, this masterfully renovated Colonial blends timeless curb appeal with top-tier modern luxury. The expansive layout flows seamlessly from a sunlit living room, stunning formal dining room and massive 24'x23' family room with a modern woodburning fireplace, dual home offices and a lower-level playroom with large mudroom. Designed as the ultimate heart of the home, the gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream-featuring a custom Raging River wood island, honed granite countertops, dual sinks, and a magnificent CornueFe 110 gas range. Upstairs, four peaceful bedrooms include a lavish primary suite with a marble shower, BainUltra soaking tub, and radiant heated floors. French doors lead to a private outdoor oasis, where a wisteria-draped pergola, covered deck, expansive terrace, sparkling pool, and spa set the stage for effortless summer entertaining-all just minutes from town and an easy walk to local schools.
